topic: Biologics and malignancy risk: lymphoma, solid tumours, non-melanoma skin cancer

source.title: Use of Biologic or Targeted Synthetic Disease-Modifying Antirheumatic Drugs and Cancer Risk
source.whyItFits: Open cohort study of cancer incidence after new biologic or targeted synthetic DMARD starts in rheumatoid arthritis, comparing rituximab, abatacept, and JAK inhibitors with TNF inhibitors and stating the confounding-by-indication limit.
